redlines.original_quote: Northmart may charge a display fee of up to $1,500 per month at its discretion.
redlines.suggested_text: Northmart may charge a display fee of up to $1,500 per month, with written notice to Supplier at least 14 days before the end of that month.
redlines.reason: In March this clause needed a question to Dana to settle a $1,200 fee. A set notice period makes the answer automatic.

redlines.original_quote: The promotional allowance applies to a maximum of 6,000 units in total.
redlines.suggested_text: The promotional allowance applies to a maximum of 6,000 units in total, including any units added by an extension. Units over the cap are not covered unless a signed amendment raises it.
redlines.reason: In March, $1,540 was taken for bars sold after the cap.

redlines.original_quote: Supplier will fund a promotional allowance of $1.00 per unit on Peak Bar Original and Peak Bar Chocolate sold between May 1 and May 31, 2026.
redlines.suggested_text: Supplier will fund a promotional allowance of $1.00 per unit on the products listed by item number in Schedule A, sold between May 1 and May 31, 2026. No other products are covered.
redlines.reason: In March, $1,000 was taken for Mint, which the deal never covered.
